scripts.start: pnpm config:api && pnpm config:auth && ng serve
scripts.build: pnpm config:api && pnpm config:auth && ng build
scripts.build:cloudflare: pnpm config:api && pnpm config:auth && ng build --configuration cloudflare
scripts.watch: pnpm config:api && pnpm config:auth && ng build --watch --configuration development
scripts.test:visual:docker: docker run --rm --ipc=host -v "$PWD/../..:/src" -v lfd-visual-pnpm-store:/pnpm-store -e CI=1 -e LFD_SKIP_GRAPHIFY=1 -e COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0 mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.1-noble bash -c 'set -e; mkdir -p /work; tar -C /src --exclude=./.git --exclude=./graphify-out --exclude=node_modules --exclude=dist --exclude=.angular --exclude=.turbo -cf - . | tar -C /work -xf -; cd /work; corepack enable; pnpm config set store-dir /pnpm-store; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter lfd-backoffice-frontend...; pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=lfd-backoffice-frontend^...; cd apps/lfd-backoffice-frontend; pnpm exec playwright test e2e/fiche-atelier-visual.spec.ts "$@"; S=e2e/fiche-atelier-visual.spec.ts-snapshots; mkdir -p /src/apps/lfd-backoffice-frontend/$S; cp -r $S/. /src/apps/lfd-backoffice-frontend/$S/' visual
